concerns.text: Task T006 (Data Generator) is marked incomplete, yet FR-002 and FR-007 require the 'Synthetic SpatialClaw Proxy' data to exist for the 2D projection and 3D baseline re-run. Without this data, the core experimental manipulation (US1) and paired comparison (US2) cannot occur. The task list fails to preserve the constraint that data generation is a blocking prerequisite.

Task T023b (Baseline Re-run) is marked incomplete. FR-007 explicitly mandates re-running the 3D baseline on the *exact same* task instances to generate a paired dataset. The task description correctly identifies this requirement but leaves the implementation undone, violating the constraint that the comparison dataset must be dynamically generated, not static.

Task T017 claims to implement stochasticity control (n≥5 runs, derived seeds) but is marked complete without evidence of the loop logic or multi-run logging infrastructure in the task description. FR-008 requires 'execute at least 5 independent runs per task instance'. A task marked 'complete' that does not explicitly describe the iteration logic or the resulting artifact (multi-run logs) semantically weakens the requirement.

Tasks T031, T031b, and T032 (Sensitivity Analysis) are unimplemented. FR-006 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping depth thresholds and reporting false-positive/negative rates. The absence of these tasks means the project cannot satisfy the requirement to 'report the resulting variation' without pre-judging outcomes, violating the methodological constraint.

Task T035b (Power Analysis) is unimplemented. SC-004 requires the experiment to complete within the GitHub Actions budget (≤6h, ≤7GB RAM). The plan explicitly states N is determined by power analysis. Without T035b, the sample size N is undefined, risking a violation of the computational feasibility constraint (SC-004).

Task T026 (Exclude blocked time from latency) is unimplemented. FR-003 requires recording wall-clock time 'excluding time spent on blocked library attempts'. Without this task, the latency metric will be contaminated by error-handling overhead, violating the accuracy constraint of the metric.

Task T011 (Logging Infrastructure) is unimplemented. FR-001 and FR-008 require logging blocked operations and seed values. Without the logging infrastructure task, the system cannot produce the verification logs required to prove the 2D constraint was enforced (US1 Independent Test) or that seeds were pinned.
